text:
keith: heads up — we had a small spike when tenant A lost v1 pin TTL and started hitting v2. quota meter showed unexpected chargebacks. anyone seen similar?

maria: saw the spike in the quota stream, looked like ~15% of A's requests switched over within a 3m window. no errors, just different latency profile.

anya: is this the TTL-unpin case where console expiry silently flips routing? we tried to avoid surprise flips for customers.

keith: yep. TTL = 0/unset leads to console falling back to 'sticky-unpinned' routing. implementation detail: we treat expired pins as a soft-unpin and allow autoswitching.

jun: quick telemetry note — our route-change metric logs the old->new model tag but doesn't capture whether the change was TTL-driven or operator-driven. makes debugging noisy.

maria: could we add a short label to the routing event: `reason=ttl_expiry`? then quota-metering could split by cause.

anya: love that. also UX ask: console should surface a small toast when tenant pins expire (or a banner under the route). customers hate silent behavior.

keith: agree. proposal: add telemetry flag + console banner + a per-tenant metric we can trend. For rollout safety, also gate automatic switch for tenants with >X qps for 5m.

jun: i can add the flag to the routing event. pseudocode:```\nemit_routing_event({route, from_tag, to_tag, reason: ttl_expiry})\n```\nthis will be in the same pipeline so low overhead.

maria: what's X? we should pick something conservative. maybe 50 rps sustained? suggestions?

anya: 50 rps is fine as a default. but product wants stickiness preserved for paid tiers — add per-tenant override in the console (pin-protect toggle).

keith: okay so flow: if pin expired and tenant.qps > threshold AND not pin-protect enabled => do not autoswitch, instead mark as `queued-for-manual-review` and surface banner.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: routing-event-flagging v1.3 -> staging at 2026-03-21T15:42:00Z :rocket:

jun: FYI that will change the event schema in ingestion. we'll need a small ETL migration for the dashboard to show new reason counts. i'll add a migration in the observability repo.

maria: dashboard change: add a stacked small multiple that breaks route-switches by reason (manual, ttl_expiry, console-toggle, fallback). also expose a filter so SREs can view only ttl_expiry spikes.

anya: and on deprecation comms: when we plan to sunsetting v1 for a route, console should show a timeline + a bulk pin-update tool to help migrate. that will reduce these accidental flips.

keith: good call. can we also retroactively flag the last 7d of routing events to show tenants who had silent unpins so customer success can proactively reach out?

jun: yes, ETL can backfill. but let's limit the backfill window to 7d to avoid large jobs.

maria: ops question — how do quotas behave when a tenant flips model? do we carry over reserved quotas? can cause sudden billing jumps.

keith: currently we apply per-model quotas independently. so moving from v1->v2 may use a different quota bucket which can be higher consumption. we should map quota buckets during pin transitions: if we detect `ttl_expiry` transition and tenant has quota-mapping set, carry over remaining allotment for 1h.

anya: implementation detail: add `quota_hold_seconds` config (default 3600). will keep billing surprises low.

jun: i'll add a schema field to routing event: `quota_hold_seconds` and emit the effective mapping.

maria: can we add a console preview showing "If we unpin now, estimated cost delta = +$X / day" ? even rough is useful.

keith: yep — we do this calc in optimize-sim already, can expose an endpoint. product/console to wire it up.

deploy-bot: note: staging deploy succeeded. routing-event-flagging v1.3 -> staging. logs: https://ci.example/reports/6248123456

anya: next steps: (1) add `reason=ttl_expiry` to events (jun), (2) add banner + pin-protect toggle (console), (3) add quota_hold_seconds logic (keith/jun), (4) dashboard small-multiples and backfill (maria). I'll open a GH meta issue to track.

keith: thanks — please ping when PRs are ready. let's avoid another surprise chargeback during the next rollover. :sweat_smile:

maria: excellent — i'll start dashboard mocks and loop in cs for outreach list.

jun: PRs incoming later today.

anya: thumbs up.
